name: qkd_host_ctl
slot_change_request: qkd_host control-leaf candidate, INSIDE the 777.576 x 518.376 host slot; own clock root. Current contract is FRAME_ONLY: host protocol termination and remote TP8 status aggregation are unresolved. This leaf preserves actual ot_host_if MODE0 engine fields and ot_qfd_pkgctl ND8 behaviour. Provisional pin_request: tk744 W/M4, hc182 N/M5, res120 E/M4, req61/pr143/ready/rst_n S/M5, ck N/M5. Die lead top-down assigned pins replace these before integration. This does not claim qkd_host or its four ingest ports implemented.

job.purpose: MU 1 (Qwen ROM 4 users, owner MU.DECIDE A 10-18) re-close of qkd_host_ctl: ot_qfd_pkgctl MU 4-slot static calendar (2-bit generation = step tag, in-order retire after all 8 dies, sticky faults flush) + hc user on pos[17:16] at the tile pin flops (MU-QWEN-HOST 433d668c5, results/rtl/mu_qwen_1018/host). Reset landing 2 stages (ROOT-RST 10-19: reset release +2 ck, scheduled constant). MU-KV-HCTL2 10-19: qkd_host_ctl-mu1-50169ecef NEEDS_RTL TT -48.75 (one path, tk_q -> u_pkg.disagree, 21 levels = the 8-die serial capture/compare chain; logic depth, not fanout or IO) -> pkgctl MU two-stage die reports (parallel capture/disagree from registered reports, +1 edge report->retire).

reroute_reason.why: rtl_change: MU 1 host plane (MU-QWEN-HOST 433d668c5) + MU-KV-HCTL2 timing fix: ot_qfd_pkgctl MU die reports in two stages (registered reports; parallel first-token capture and disagreement; +1 edge report->retire) because qkd_host_ctl-mu1-50169ecef routed TT -48.75 on the 21-level serial 8-die compare chain into u_pkg.disagree. Benches results/rtl/mu_qwen_1018/host/runs_hctl2 (Verilator 5.050): tb_qkd_host_ctl_mu PASS, cm1-cm5 FAIL, MU 0 13/13 host benches identical to origin/main. Closed hc1-71ffdaf23 is the single-user (MU 0) view; the release die is the MU die (owner 0kc 10-19).

pin_regs.reason: RTL registers every pin: ready/req/pr/tk are captured into ready_q/req_q/pr_q/tk_q with no input logic, res leaves a register, hc = pr_q + the pkgctl registered d_* fields (rtl/physical/ot_qwen_host_ctl.sv header; closed hc1-71ffdaf23 view had the same boundary). A flow pin stage would add a cycle the host calendar does not have.
